question: The two streams Chandra and Bhaga rise on the opposite sides of the Baralacha pass to form which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chenab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chenab originates from near the** Bara Lacha Pass **in the **Lahul-Spiti part of the Zaskar Range**.
 
• The two streams, the **Chandra and the Bhaga** join at **Tandi in Himachal Pradesh** forming the Chenab river (also known as the Chandrabhaga river).
 
• It is traditionally known as the **Chandrabhaga River**, which is a major river that flows in **India and Pakistan**.
 
• It is the largest tributary of the **Indus river**.
 
• Its important tributaries are the **Marusadar River, Miyar Nalla, Sohal and Thirot**.
 
• Major dam on the Chenab river is **Pakal Dul Dam, Dul Hasti Hydroelectric Plant, Baglihar Hydroelectric power project and Salal Dam**.
 
• The **world's highest rail bridge** is formed above the Chenab river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7702f7e421f5ff39de708ed61868462099a3a47eb363852cf8cae57d58c2196.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **
